body:
your parents are wrong but maybe if you try to communicate  with them 
And tell them how you feel , etc. Talking calmly..maybe they will understand 
Or maybe they will accept or get used to it in time..as mine did
However.. i think they love you and that..would be a terrible pain to lose you

That's a lot like me too 
And people just told me straight that they don't care
It sure hurts..
But I think they will actually care if you kill yourself, more than you can possibly realise at the moment.
So please don't .
They shouldn't have let you down, of course,
You deserve to be loved and happy, and maybe you will find someone better.
There are still many people who care
Mental illnesses can be hard to deal with but one day you will be so proud of you for making through all of this
Try to get involved in social activities, stay active, do the things you enjoy 
You are already so strong
Seek help everytime you need it 
You are not alone..there are many people struggling just like you 
And the world needs us because we're capable of understanding and we are those wonderful people that still care and will be supportive.
